# fct_hotel_preference_responses

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.fct_hotel_preference_responses` · dbt area: `portal`

Fact table for individual hotel and brand preferences submitted via intake forms. Each row represents a single hotel or brand preference mention by a client. Unnested from the hotel_preferences field in fct_intake_form_responses to enable analysis of individual hotel/brand mentions. Sourced from the Portal database.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `hotel_preference_response_id` | Primary Key. Unique identifier for each hotel preference mention. >> SOURCE - Portal data_tests: - unique - not_null |
| `advisor_id` | Foreign Key. The User ID of the Advisor who created the intake form. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `client_id` | Foreign Key. The unique identifier for the Contact who submitted this preference. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `hotel_or_brand_name` | Name of the hotel or brand preferred by the client. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `intake_form_id` | Foreign Key. Unique ID for the intake form that this preference is associated with. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `intake_form_response_id` | Foreign Key. Links to the intake form response where this preference was submitted. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_most_recent_response` | True/false flag for the most recent intake form response submitted by a Client. One intake form response can include multiple hotel preferences. >> SOURCE - Portal. |
| `notes` | Additional notes or context about this hotel preference. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `preference_type` | Type of preference (e.g., hotel vs chain/brand). >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `response_sequence` | Sequence of intake form responses given by a Client, where 1 is the most recent response. A response can include multiple hotel preferences. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `supplier_brand_id` | Foreign Key. Links to the supplier brand in the supplier_brands table. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `supplier_group_id` | Foreign Key. Links to the supplier group in the supplier_groups table. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `supplier_id` | Foreign Key. Links to the supplier in the suppliers table. >> SOURCE - Portal |
